name: Number lines and betweenness
definition: A number line puts numbers in order and shows how far apart they are. Reading one means working out what each tick mark is worth first, then locating the value. Questions ask which number sits between two others, or what a marked point must be.
recognizeWhen: a point is marked on the number line
which number is between these two
the arrow points somewhere along the scale
put these numbers in order from smallest
misconceptions: I assumed each tick mark was worth one without checking the scale.
I counted the tick marks instead of the spaces between them.
I ordered negative numbers as if the bigger digit meant the bigger number.
